description:
Make Soniox selectable for the final transcript on its own (live local, final Soniox), using the Soniox async file API through the cloud final-provider interface from the pipeline dispatch ticket.

- Upload recording WAV, create transcription with speaker diarization, poll, normalize to final tokens + turns (reuse SonioxNormalizer token mapping), delete the remote file/transcription after fetching.
- Whitelist/CORS for the async endpoints on api.soniox.com (already whitelisted host; confirm endpoints).
- Resolver: provides stt-final; vad locked only if live is off.

Lower priority than Speechmatics; it rounds out "every role can pick any service".
title: Soniox async final transcript option
